name: realoptions-node-sdk
description: SDK for real options for both client and node

scripts.get_spec: curl -o references.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/realoptions/option_price_faas/master/docs/references.yml && curl -o spec.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/realoptions/option_price_faas/master/docs/spec.yml && curl -o gcp_auth.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/realoptions/option_price_faas/master/docs/gcp_auth.yml
scripts.mock-api-background: npm run get_spec && nohup npx --yes --package=@stoplight/prism-cli prism mock gcp_auth.yml &
scripts.mock-api: npm run get_spec && npx --yes --package=@stoplight/prism-cli prism mock gcp_auth.yml

author: Daniel Stahl
